findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (50.83 yds from volume vs 48.34 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.51 per player (projected 30.55, actual 31.06).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.01 (projected 7.17, actual 7.16).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 66.15, without it 64.16. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 25/67 (37.31%). Our MAE 66.15 vs the line's 60.07. The book is the better projection.
